dialogues.speaker: Vinayak
dialogues.text: If Shriya's hypotheses are correct, this will be the Wenutslayer Cannon's most critical battle. Brave adventurer, are you ready?

response.speaker: Vinayak
response.text: Alright then, let us begin! Let us prove to all of Sumeru that this cannon isn't just a pretty face!

response.speaker: Vinayak
response.text: Alright then. Planning ahead is good for efficiency, after all...

response.speaker: Shriya
response.text: Huh. Is it just me, or has your attitude improved a little?
